message:
All tests pass now: 2 of 2 in `npm test`.

The only failure was in `test/vat.test.js`. It asserted `withVat(250)` equals 301, but 20% of 250 pence is exactly 50 pence, so the correct total is 300. `src/vat.js` was already right, so I changed the expected value from 301 to 300 in the test and left the source alone. Making the code return 301 would have meant introducing a rounding rule that doesn't exist.

I haven't committed the change.
